screens.title: Explore
screens.purpose: Discover destinations: a large featured photo, a floating glass search bar, category filters, a carousel of popular places and great deals.
acceptance: A full-width travel photo fills the top of the screen, with the featured destination's name in large white text
A rounded, translucent search bar with the text “Where to?” floats over the photo, near the top
A row of filters (All, Beaches, Mountains…) is visible, with the first one highlighted
Photo cards of popular destinations, each with a rating pill, start below the filters
A bottom tab bar shows Explore, Trips, Saved and Profile

screens.title: Trips
screens.purpose: Upcoming trips as photo cards with dates and a countdown, totals, and a way to plan a new trip.
acceptance: The title “My trips” is shown with a round add button on the right
Three tiles show the number of trips, nights and countries
At least three trip cards show a photo, a white title and a date pill

screens.title: Saved
screens.purpose: Saved destinations, as a two-column grid of photo cards.
acceptance: The title “Saved” is shown with the number of saved destinations
Saved destinations appear as photo cards in two columns, each with a name and a country

screens.title: Profile
screens.purpose: The traveler's profile: avatar, yearly goal, stats, appearance picker and preferences.
acceptance: A card shows an avatar with initials, the name “Camille Martin” and a progress bar
A segmented control with Auto, Light and Dark is visible
A preferences list contains a toggle and rows for currency and home airport

screens.title: Destination
screens.purpose: A single destination: a large photo, a glass panel with country, name, rating and key facts, a description, must-see highlights and a floating price bar to plan a trip.
acceptance: A large photo fills the top of the screen, with round back and heart buttons over it
A translucent panel overlapping the photo shows the country, the destination name in large type and a star rating
A description and a numbered list of must-see highlights appear below the panel
A bottom bar shows a price in euros and a “Plan trip” button

screens.title: New trip
screens.purpose: A sheet to create a trip: name, destinations, departure month, number of nights and estimated budget.
acceptance: The title “New trip” is shown with a close button
Destination chips with small round photos are shown, at least one selected
A duration row has minus and plus buttons around a number of nights
An estimated budget in euros and a “Create trip” button are visible
